Windows only: Trakt account sign-in now uses OAuth PKCE (S256) and the owner's public Client ID, with no Client Secret needed. Settings > Trakt can import completed, dated movie and TV-episode history from local/private TorriODB into the authorized Trakt account. Xperience needs the same account linked, Trakt History selected and personalized Home rows enabled. Incomplete watches remain incomplete. Existing TorBox, playback, subtitles, video, audio, local history and iOS builds are preserved.
